metadata.description: Personal Claude Code marketplace: one /task workflow plus stack check plugins (frontend, server incl. Supabase).

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Backlog-driven work loop as one skill: /task create, /task start, /task end. Scales planning to task size, verifies once before done, and reviews with code-review plus the stack reviewers of enabled plugins.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Frontend checks for /task start and /task end (Svelte and React references), browser verification, and the frontend-reviewer agent.

plugins.name: server
plugins.description: Backend and Supabase checks for /task start and /task end (any server language and Supabase: migrations, API contract, RLS, keys) and the api-reviewer and supabase-reviewer agents.
